categories.main_business_segments: eBASE Co., Ltd. operates two main business segments: the 'eBASE business,' which develops and sells package software and cloud services for product information management (including the core CMS platform 'Middleware eBASE'), and the 'eBASE-PLUS business,' which provides IT development outsourcing services such as contract development, system operation, and server maintenance. The eBASE business is further structured around three business model phases (0th, 1st, and 2nd eBASE), targeting B2B and B2B2C markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is the proprietary CMS development platform 'Middleware eBASE,' which enables efficient development and customization of product information databases and related solutions. The platform supports both on-premises and cloud (SaaS) deployments, with features such as one-source multi-use data management, database publishing, and integration with various media and business systems. The company emphasizes low-code/no-code development tools, automated testing, and continuous UI/UX improvements, as well as patented data normalization and champion data creation methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: eBASE primarily serves enterprises in the food, daily goods, pharmaceutical, stationery, electronics, tools, and housing industries, including manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, and private brand (PB) divisions. Its solutions are widely adopted by major retailers, supermarkets, convenience stores, home centers, and manufacturers seeking to optimize product information management, digital marketing, and supply chain collaboration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with headquarters in Osaka and offices in Tokyo and Kagawa. All reported sales and assets are domestic, and there is no significant overseas revenue or assets as of the reporting period, though some solutions are multilingual and positioned for inbound and potential overseas expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: eBASE operates primarily as a midstream technology provider, supplying product information management platforms and services that connect upstream manufacturers and suppliers with downstream wholesalers, retailers, and end consumers. Its solutions facilitate data exchange and digital transformation across the supply chain, supporting both B2B and B2B2C models.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the adoption of the eBASE platform as the de facto standard for product information exchange, enhancing cloud and SaaS offerings, and driving digital transformation (DX) and customer experience (CX) improvements for clients. R&D focuses on strengthening the core middleware, developing new options and mobile apps, integrating AI and data science, and securing patents for unique features. The company also invests in IT talent development through proprietary e-learning systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of package software sales, customization and integration projects, recurring license and support fees, cloud/SaaS subscriptions, and IT development outsourcing contracts. The eBASE-PLUS segment provides stable, contract-based revenue from IT outsourcing, while the eBASE segment combines one-time and recurring income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: eBASE faces competition from other product information management and CMS software vendors, including both domestic and global players. The company differentiates itself by aiming for de facto standardization in targeted industries and by offering highly customizable, integrated solutions. While it holds a strong position in certain Japanese verticals, it acknowledges the risk of new entrants and technology shifts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 5.47 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.73 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 1.25 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady revenue and profit growth over the past five years, maintains a high equity ratio (over 90%), and has a workforce of 478 employees. Cash flow is robust, and the company is financially stable with significant internal reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: eBASE emphasizes its ability to deliver efficient, integrated product information management across industries, enabling clients to achieve cost reductions, digital transformation, and improved customer experience through one-source multi-use data and seamless OMO (Online Merges with Offline) solutions. Its proprietary middleware, industry-standard data pools, and patented technologies provide unique value, while its flexible, scalable offerings support both enterprise and consumer-facing digital initiatives.
